name: proteome-counts-are-read-from-the-orthomcl-data-summary
turns: How many proteins and ortholog groups does each Plasmodium falciparum proteome have?
rationale: OrthoMCL keeps its proteome counts in the DataSummary table of its helper record. The turn reads the table and states the counts.

provenance.curatorNote: 5318 proteins in 3891 groups is the P. falciparum 3D7 proteome on QA OrthoMCL.
